description: This file is a command-line interface (CLI) program for managing Playwright browser sessions, including commands like list, open, close, install, and kill daemons. It handles user input, session management, browser configuration, and process control.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Represents a browser session, providing methods to run commands, check connectivity, and manage session lifecycle.

methods.name: program
methods.description: Main entry point for the CLI, parsing arguments and dispatching commands.

methods.name: runInSession
methods.description: Executes a command within a specific browser session.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles installation of workspace and skills.

methods.name: ensureConfiguredBrowserInstalled
methods.description: Checks and installs the configured browser if necessary.

methods.name: findOrInstallDefaultBrowser
methods.description: Detects or installs a default browser.

methods.name: defaultConfigFile
methods.description: Returns the path to the default config file.

methods.name: killAllDaemons
methods.description: Kills all running daemon processes related to the application.

methods.name: listSessions
methods.description: Lists all active and available sessions.

methods.name: gcAndPrintSessions
methods.description: Garbage collects and prints session statuses.

methods.name: renderSessionStatus
methods.description: Renders the status of a session.

methods.name: calculateSha1
methods.description: Calculates SHA-1 hash of a buffer or string.
